spec.objective: Verify that retrying a payment on a slow network does not send duplicate requests and the pending state is handled correctly.
spec.journey_description: A user makes a payment on a slow network and the app shows a pending status, then retries the payment.

supported_conditions.note: Bandwidth cap through the host shaping proxy (apps that use the system proxy).

expected_behaviour: The app must display an honest pending state after the initial payment
upon retry, it must not send a duplicate request
the final state must match the bank status.

machine_checked_assertions.label: While the bank has not confirmed, the app does not say the payment failed
A retry never charges the user twice
The final screen matches what the bank recorded

execution.reason: Runs the 'UPI-style payment pending + retry' scenario with machine-checked assertions on the BharatPay Mock fixture, plus the generic baseline vs persona run.

spec.symptom_label: the app shows a wrong result or state
